text: The initiative, titled 'Scaling Climate and Disaster Risk Financing Framework and Parametric Insurance in Fiji,' aims to provide rapid financial relief following extreme weather events through parametric insurance. Launched in 2020 and scaled in 2023, it integrates public policy, development finance, private insurance, and digital payment systems to deliver quick payouts. The program targets vulnerable groups, including low-to-moderate income households, farmers, women, and MSMEs, with a focus on tropical cyclone winds and heavy rainfall.
